column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Be jealous of” is rendered “envy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “His intimacy is with the upright” is rendered “He is intimate with the upright.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Humble people” is rendered “the afflicted,” and “favor” as “grace.”
“Fools [are] lifting up shame” is rendered “fools display dishonor.” The meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
